1.

Thy love, O Father, mighty, free, Has sought and found the captives here, And through the precious work of Jesus, Thou dost bestow life and liberty upon them.

2.

In the house of bondage Thou didst see us, Tightly bound in sin’s chains; Though far from Thee, O our God, We were reached by Thy saving hand.

3.

The grace which Thine only Son gave, As ransom for our guilt, Has set us free and now teaches us To love Thee, our gracious Father.

4.

And Thou hast given us the Son, To be brought home, our God, to Thee. As “sons” and “brethren” now, We follow in the path of His footsteps.

5.

There above, where Thy love’s sun Shines brightly in righteousness, There through Jesus’ blood we see Our title to eternal glory.

6.

Partakers of Thy nature, Even now, though we walk in the wilderness, With hearts fixed upon Thy Son, We share in Thy love’s joy.

7.

Thou art love, O keep us then So near, yea so near to Thee, That we ourselves may disappear, And Christ be manifested in us.
